concepts.label: Delete (Full-Text) Index - Web Console UI action

notable_absence.finding: Same gap as search/create-search-indexes.json - no privilege documented for this destructive UI action. Also notably thin content overall (14 lines) - reads as an older-generation FTS doc, a distinct authoring convention from both the N1QL reference pages and the newer search/ pages.

cross_component_finding.observation: fts/ and search/ appear to be two documentation generations covering overlapping functionality (older 'Full-Text Search' branding vs newer 'Search' service docs) - e.g. both trees have their own 'index aliases' and index-management pages (server/7.2/fts/fts-create-index-aliases.md vs server/7.2/search/create-search-index-alias.md; this page vs the create/customize pages under search/). This is a possible content-duplication or migration-in-progress signal, independent of the linked-data ontology work - flagging for a subject-matter expert to judge, not something this exercise should try to resolve on its own.
